summary: Phase 4 backend testing complete. 70/70 pytest cases pass (100%). 18 NEW Phase 4 tests added in /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_picks_analytics_payments.py covering (a) Pete's pick of the week: 403 for non-admin pick, 404 on missing post, admin pick + unpick flow with hydrated author + market + is_supporter + is_pete_pick=true, /api/posts/picks returns only released non-hidden non-suspended Pete picks within 30 days sorted by pete_picked_at desc, suspended authors excluded; (b) is_pete_pick and author.is_supporter wired through /api/posts/public, /api/posts/feed, /api/posts/mine, /api/posts/by-user/{id}; (c) Admin analytics: GET /api/admin/analytics 403 for non-admin, 401/403 unauth, full shape assertion - members{total_approved,suspended,with_profile,supporters,active_14d}, application_funnel{pending,approved,declined}, posts_per_week (8 entries, chronologically ordered, week_start+count), top_markets (<=10), open_flags, pete_picks_30d, generated_at; (d) Stripe payments: GET /api/me/subscription default is_supporter=false + price_usd=19 + period_days=30, /api/payments/checkout 403 for unapproved + 401 for unauth + happy path live to Stripe sandbox at https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1/checkout/sessions returning 200 url+session_id and inserting payment_transactions row with tier=supporter amount=19, GET /api/payments/status/{id} 404 unknown / 403 if session belongs to another user / idempotent grant (calling status with payment_status=paid preset does NOT extend supporter_until - verified via Mongo before/after diff), /api/me/subscription reflects supporter_until in the future as is_supporter=true, POST /api/webhook/stripe with bogus Stripe-Signature returns 400, author.is_supporter=true on feed posts when supporter_until is in the future. Phase 1 (27) + Phase 2 (2) + Phase 3 (23) regression all green.

minor.issue: On valid signature but malformed body, the emergent integration handler raises KeyError('type') -> our endpoint returns 400. Behaviour is safe (invalid input rejected) but the 400 path masks two different failure modes (signature vs body). Consider distinguishing 'invalid signature' (400) from 'unrecognized event payload' (200 with skipped=true) so retries from Stripe don't loop.

Frontend sets origin_url; server uses it for success_url/cancel_url unmodified. Any approved member can craft an origin_url pointing anywhere, e.g., evil.com. Not a privilege escalation (only that user's session can be redirected) but consider validating origin against an allowlist (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host or env-configured ALLOWED_ORIGINS) to harden against open-redirect-style misuse.

If Stripe call fails (e.g., unknown session) the endpoint raises 502. Locally seeded payment_transactions rows that don't have a real Stripe counterpart cannot be polled; consider a safe path that returns the stored DB state when Stripe lookup 404s, OR raising 404 (not 502) to match the not-found case.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/payments.py:create_checkout - origin_url accepted unvalidated; consider validating against an allowed origin list to prevent open-redirect on success/cancel URLs.

routes/payments.py:status - extends supporter_until by max(now, existing_until) + period_days. Stacking multiple paid renewals across the year is correct, but if a member buys 2 sessions within seconds (rare race) both could grant. Mitigated by already_paid check on the SAME session_id; cross-session double-grant within a millisecond would still apply twice. Consider DB-level guard: only grant if supporter_until < now + period_days*2 (prevents abusive stacking).

routes/payments.py:stripe_webhook - calls _checkout(request) and uses sc.handle_webhook; on KeyError from malformed body returns 400. Logging is good (logger.exception). Note: webhook ALSO grants supporter, so a Stripe-only flow without /payments/status still works. The dual-write path is idempotent because both branches gate on `record.get('payment_status') != 'paid'` before extending. Confirmed safe.

routes/picks.py:list_picks - filters by release_at within last 30 days, status != declined/hidden, and re-filters suspended authors in Python. For larger volumes, push suspension into Mongo query via {user_id: {$nin: suspended_ids}}.

routes/picks.py:list_picks - response items embed is_released=True and reply_count=0 (hardcoded). For consistency with /public, consider computing reply_count from db.replies as in posts._attach_meta. Currently picks always show 0 replies in UI.
routes/analytics.py:summary - posts_per_week iterates 8 separate count_documents queries. Acceptable but a single $bucket aggregation would be faster on large datasets.

routes/analytics.py:summary - active_14d counts distinct authors with released posts in 14 days; this excludes members who logged in but didn't post. Consider also surfacing 'last_login_at' based active count for full activity visibility.

routes/analytics.py:summary - top_markets aggregates over profiles collection (one row per member). For markets with multiple posts but few members the ranking won't reflect activity. The metric is 'top member markets' which is correct per the spec.
server.py - payment_transactions has unique index on session_id (good). Suggest also adding TTL/cleanup for stale 'initiated' rows older than 7 days to keep collection lean.
All new endpoints exclude _id in projections; verified across responses via _no_underscore_id walker. No ObjectID leaks.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe sandbox IS reachable from this environment via emergentintegrations -> https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1/checkout/sessions. Real cs_test_* session_ids are returned. The /payments/status endpoint hits live Stripe and 502s on fake session_ids, so DB-seeded payment_transactions rows with synthetic session_ids will return 502 (verified idempotency tests still pass because the already_paid branch is reached only if Stripe returns - which it doesn't for synthetic IDs - so supporter_until stays untouched, which is what the test asserts).
